# AI Terminal Tools Comparison

### Claude Code, Forge Code and Gemini CLI given the same three tasks

The code that Claude Code, Forge Code and Gemini CLI generated for the same three tasks: a landing page, a multi-file React debugging exercise and a retro endless runner game.

<br />

[![Built by Studio1](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built_by_Studio1-f97316?style=for-the-badge&logo=data%3Aimage%2Fsvg%2Bxml%3Bbase64%)](https://studio1hq.com)

[More examples](https://github.com/Studio1HQ) &nbsp;·&nbsp; [studio1hq.com](https://studio1hq.com)

</div>

<br />

## Overview

This repo contains the code generated by three AI terminal coding tools, Claude Code, Forge Code and Gemini CLI, when given the same three tasks. Each tool has its own folder with its own output, so you can open them side by side and compare.

The prompts and any scoring are not stored here. The repo is the raw output.

## Features

- **Landing page**: a static page (`index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`) built by each tool.
- **Multi-file debug**: a React, TypeScript and Vite blog app (`Blog`, `BlogContext`, `Editor`, `useAutosave`, `useBlog`) as it stood after each tool worked on it.
- **Retro endless runner**: a browser game in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript from each tool.
- **Identical layout**: every tool folder has the same three subfolders, which makes diffs easy.

## Tech stack

| Layer | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Tools compared | [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code), Forge Code, [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) |
| Debug task app | [React](https://react.dev) 19, TypeScript, [Vite](https://vite.dev) |
| Landing page and game | HTML, CSS, JavaScript |

## Getting started

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18 or later for the multi-file debug projects
- A web browser for the landing pages and games

### Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Studio1HQ/AI-Terminal-Tools-Comparison.git
cd AI-Terminal-Tools-Comparison
```

### Run

Landing pages and games need no build. Open the `index.html` file in your browser, for example `claude-code/landing-page/index.html` or `gemini-cli/retro-endless-running/index.html`.

For a multi-file debug project, install and start Vite in its folder:

```bash
cd claude-code/multi-file-debug
npm install
npm run dev
```

The other scripts are `npm run build`, `npm run lint` and `npm run preview`.

## How it works

```text
claude-code/
  landing-page/
  multi-file-debug/
  retro-endless-running/
forge-code/
  landing-page/
  multi-file-debug/
  retro-endless-running/
gemini-cli/
  landing-page/
  multi-file-debug/
  retro-endless-running/
```

Compare a task across tools by diffing the same subfolder, for example `claude-code/multi-file-debug` against `forge-code/multi-file-debug`.

## Resources

- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code): Anthropic's terminal coding agent.
- [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli): Google's terminal coding agent.
